$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the skills list. `displayed` + `external` appear on /skills, IN THIS ORDER (scripts/generate-skills-content.mjs builds the page data from the skill files in registry order); `unlisted` are internal-only. Every .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md must be registered here; external skills keep their published copy in website/src/data/external-skills/<name>.md. scripts/validate-skills-registry.mjs enforces all of this at build time.
